meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 统一管理多智能体角色的团队协作框架，支持智能体动态组合、灵活协作和扩展新角色。智能体本质上是"角色定义"，可以根据任务需求灵活组建团队，实现从会议决策到系统构建的完整能力。智能体角色明确分工：有干活的、有指挥的、有挑毛病的，能实时看到沟通过程，共享数据库记忆，确保上下文一致。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体团队协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理多个智能体角色并协调它们协作完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent teams to collaborate on tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple AI agents and coordinate their collaboration

howto.what: 将多个智能体角色组成团队,按执行、管理、评审分工协作;讨论过程实时可见,共享同一数据库记忆,最终产出会议记录、方案或代码等协作结果。
howto.when: 当任务需要多个智能体协同、多角度分析,或需要按场景组建团队时触发;也可通过预设团队配置(如技术决策、OPC构建)调用。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: 各智能体会发言、辩论并形成共识

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建一个AI短视频脚本生成系统
say.note: 战略、产品、工程角色会接力完成任务

say.text: 请用产品团队制定我们新产品的定价策略
say.note: 你会看到市场分析、成本核算和定价讨论过程

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a team coordinator that assembles multiple AI agents with distinct roles (executor, manager, reviewer). Discussions are shown in real time, agents share one database memory, and the output is a collaborative result such as meeting notes, plans, or code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs multi-agent collaboration, multi-perspective analysis, or a scenario-based team. You can also start it via preset team setups like technical decision or OPC building.

say_en.text: Evaluate the microservices architecture with the technical decision team.
say_en.note: Agents will speak, debate, and reach consensus.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build an AI short-video script system.
say_en.note: Strategy, product, and engineering roles work in sequence.

say_en.text: Use the product team to set a pricing strategy for our new product.
say_en.note: You'll see market analysis, cost checks, and pricing discussion.
